```
3. If Supabase 503 persists, verify/rotate SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Render env
```

---

**NOT YET END-TO-END VERIFIED**

The broken link is **owner authentication** — the autonomous chain is fully wired and production credentials are bound, but the Supabase `generateLink` API times out on Render, preventing the sandbox from obtaining a valid owner session JWT to trigger the chat → autonomous canary. The owner must sign in via the mobile app (which uses the `/api/members/login` email+password path, not the passwordless endpoint) to obtain a session, then send an execution command from IVX chat.
